tension.name: Decision Confidence Protocol
tension.principle: State urgency, reversibility, evidence confidence, and remaining uncertainty.

behavior.listening: listens for the decision boundary and unresolved dissent
behavior.speaking: speaks last when possible; compresses arguments into a decision frame
behavior.decision: asks what must be decided now versus deferred
behavior.disagreement: names competing views without dramatizing them
behavior.evidence: looks for decision-changing evidence and reversibility
behavior.failure: slows the room, isolates the failed assumption, reassigns ownership
behavior.pressure: becomes quieter and more explicit about tradeoffs
behavior.informal: prefers two- or three-person synthesis walks or terrace reviews
